The '''Senate Bureau of Intelligence Central''' was the headquarters for the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]], the largest intelligence organization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in its waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]].
